requirements.condition: When implementing the experimental MB record RDATA format.
requirements.required_behavior: Represent MB RDATA as a single MADNAME field.
requirements.why_checkable: The MB RDATA serializer and parser can be checked for the single field shown in the format diagram.

requirements.quote:
3.3.3. MB RDATA format (EXPERIMENTAL)

    +--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+
    /                   MADNAME                     /
    /                                               /
    +--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+

where:

MADNAME         A <domain-name> which specifies a host which has the
                specified mailbox.
requirements.condition: When encoding or decoding MADNAME in an implemented experimental MB record.
requirements.required_behavior: Encode and interpret MADNAME as a domain name.
requirements.why_checkable: The MADNAME field codec can be checked for domain-name representation.

requirements.quote:
3.3.3. MB RDATA format (EXPERIMENTAL)

    +--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+
    /                   MADNAME                     /
    /                                               /
    +--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+

where:

MADNAME         A <domain-name> which specifies a host which has the
                specified mailbox.
requirements.condition: When constructing or interpreting an implemented experimental MB record.
requirements.required_behavior: Use MADNAME to specify a host that has the specified mailbox.
requirements.why_checkable: A controlled mailbox and host fixture can verify that the MB target represents the mailbox host.

requirements.condition: When processing an implemented experimental MB record.
requirements.required_behavior: Trigger additional-section processing that looks up A resource records corresponding to MADNAME.
requirements.why_checkable: Additional-section processing can be observed with an MB record whose MADNAME has known A records.
